name: rides
description: Rides in someone's car, across town or between cities.
howDealsGo: The rider pays into escrow when the ride is agreed and releases at drop-off, or pays and releases in one tap at the end. Done is the rider at the destination. A timer to the driver, set past the ride, pays for a ride given if the rider goes quiet. Before riding, check the driver's standing and the car's plate.
